columns.rationale: null_rate is 0.0 with null_count 0 and distinct_count 16 equal to the 16-row table, matching the two-letter IATA codes sampled (9E, AA, AS, ... YV); renamed to carrier_code per the operator's code-column convention.

null_rate is 0.0 with 16 distinct full carrier names sampled (e.g. 'Delta Air Lines Inc.', 'Southwest Airlines Co.'); renamed from the ambiguous 'name' to carrier_name to spell out what the column holds per operator guidance.
is_airbyte_metadata is true, a capture-tool UUID with null_rate 0.0 that carries no business meaning and is dropped per the pipeline-metadata rule.
is_airbyte_metadata is true with a single constant value '2026-09-02T23:26:17' (min=max) across all 16 rows, a capture timestamp dropped per the pipeline-metadata rule.
is_airbyte_metadata is true with a single distinct value '{}' across all 16 rows, a capture-tool artifact dropped per the pipeline-metadata rule.

decisions.rationale: dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across dataset.row_count 16, so no exact-duplicate removal is required.
carrier_code has distinct_count 16 equal to row_count 16 with null_rate 0.0, so one row per carrier code is the smallest defensible grain for this lookup table.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so they are dropped from silver.
The operator context specifies code columns take a _code suffix, so bronze carrier becomes silver carrier_code.

purpose: This table is the cleaned carrier lookup for the sixteen airlines that flew out of New York City in 2013, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal name, and feeds any flight-fact table that needs to resolve or display a readable carrier name.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on carrier_code to attach the full carrier_name; both columns are fully populated and unique per the declared grain, so no null-filtering or deduplication is needed before joining.
limitations: The table excludes three Airbyte capture-metadata columns that carried no business content; because duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 and every value was fully populated across all 16 rows, no additional cleanup, imputation, or dedupe logic was required or applied.
